g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
SS 304 frame; UHMW hubs; urethane + silicone rollers
No product contact (container closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: FRONT VIEW (1:3), JAR ON THE ROLLERS, ARM DOWN
RIGHT SIDE VIEW (1:3), FROM +X, WEB PATH
Label web (dashed red) from the unwind roll over the guide and the peel plate to the tip; liner (dash-dot)
returns under the plate to the liner drive nip and the rewind. Container turns: label goes on at the top.
Core hubs UHMW (unwind with flange, rewind)
TBL-2 top 914 [35.984] AFF; 4 x M6 through the bench top
shaker Ø66 x 109.2; jar Ø86.4 x 154.9, lying cap toward +x
fence 105 at S or J holes
shaker 80 x 190, jar 100 x 255; 3 in core, 200 OD
120 V 1-ph 15 A receptacle, cord 3 m, 1.2 A
1. Operator: lay the container on the rollers against the fence, lower the arm (right hand): the label runs and
stops at the next gap; lift the arm, take the container.
2. Change S ↔ J: fence to the S or J holes (2 screws), peel bracket to the S or J holes (2 screws), select S / J on
the box, load the label roll, teach the gap sensor.
3. Rollers, liner drive and container surface all run at the same speed through the two timing belts: no adjustment
4. No product contact: the container is closed and capped; all steel 304, #4 brushed. Hardware A2-70 unless noted
